sources.title: Phren Craft – Celtic Modular Identity System
sources.creator: Ivana Mundja
sources.observation: A detailed emblem, large serif name and small uppercase tagline establish three distinct levels, organized by strong panel gutters.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Use clear scale roles and consistent alignment; reduce detail for a personal message viewed at thumbnail size.
sources.doNotCopy: Phren Craft’s dragon, knotwork, wordmark, exact palette or modular board. Its heraldic density would distract from the bouquet.

sources.title: Cubee – Visual Identity Toolkit | Brand System
sources.creator: Dtail Branding for Dtail Studio
sources.observation: Oversized sans typography dominates small explanatory columns; broad margins separate roles, while a geometric repeat connects applications.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Let scale and spacing establish hierarchy. A single florist post needs fewer elements than an identity manual.
sources.doNotCopy: Cubee’s symbol, pattern, green identity, slogans or diagonal presentation arrangement.

sources.title: Floral poster design for flower shop branding
sources.creator: lexielogo
sources.observation: Description only: the supplied notes identify dark brown, tan, terracotta and muted blue swatches. Hierarchy, typography, spacing and image treatment cannot be assessed.
sources.transferablePrinciple: Consider warm ink against the supplied photograph’s cool sky, assigning colors specific contrast roles rather than importing an entire palette.
sources.doNotCopy: The palette as a replacement brand identity, or any unseen typography, imagery or layout.

routes.name: The handover
routes.concept: An editorial composition that leads from the occasion into the woman’s hands holding the gift.
routes.brandConnection: Help adults see their first Mother’s Day order as a personal gesture, with the supplied demo offer supporting that decision. The real bouquet expresses the florist’s purpose; expressive serif type, deliberate spacing and photographic emphasis interpret the saved taste.
routes.composition: 1080×1350. Place the editable photo at x0/y350, 1080×1000, using cover with an approximate source crop of x400–1506 and full height. Preserve face, bouquet and both hands. Share x64 alignment: “Petal and Flowers” at top; first-read “Mother’s Day” on two lines, with “Day” entering the photographed sky; “Your first order. Her special day.” around y475, then “50% off” around y565. Place “Go now →” beside the stems in lower-left sky. Use 64px safe insets and a 16/32px spacing rhythm.
routes.typography: Georgia regular, approximately 166px, for the two-line occasion. Arial supplies the 32px brand, 34px supporting copy and action, and bold 84px offer. Break the personal line between its two sentences.
routes.colorLogic: Deep bark text on a pale sky-blue upper field and the photograph’s clear sky. Bouquet pinks provide warmth. Position body copy for at least 4.5:1 local contrast.
routes.originalTwist: “Day” crosses from the flat sky-colored margin into real photographed sky. The reading path ends beside the tied stems, connecting the action to the gift being held.

routes.name: Held between words
routes.concept: The two words of the occasion form a typographic embrace around the complete photograph.
routes.brandConnection: Give the caring gesture priority for adults choosing a thoughtful gift, while keeping the first-order offer easy to find. Monumental type and an uncropped photograph translate the editorial preference into a warm, balanced composition.
routes.composition: Place the complete editable photograph at x0/y360, 1080×720, preserving its original proportions. “Mother’s” sits above it; “Day” begins around y1040 in the lower-left sky and continues below the image. Together they read “Mother’s Day.” Align “Petal and Flowers” at x64 near the top. Inside the photo’s left sky, place “Your first order. Her special day.” around y405, “50% off” around y580 and “Go now →” around y850. Keep all text clear of flowers, face and hands.
routes.typography: Arial bold gives “Mother’s” approximately 200px and “Day” 240px, creating a broad opening and emphatic close. Georgia regular supplies 34px personal copy; Arial handles the 32px brand/action and 76px offer.
routes.colorLogic: Flat pale rose above and below the photograph, with dark warm ink throughout. Retain the photograph’s blue sky and natural flower colors; verify body contrast at its actual placement.
routes.originalTwist: The holiday wording visibly holds the whole photograph between its two words. Offer and action remain inside the original sky, integrated with the gift scene.

routes.name: An open invitation
routes.concept: An oversized offer creates an opening into an offset photograph of the personal gift.
routes.brandConnection: Address the first-order decision directly while the intact bouquet scene and personal line retain the florist’s caring purpose. Confident scale, one photograph and controlled asymmetry suit the saved minimal, expressive taste.
routes.composition: First read “50% off”: a giant “50%” around x64/y280, with “off” continuing below at left. Place “Petal and Flowers” at x64/y64 and supporting “Mother’s Day” around y140. Set the editable photo at x250/y550, 830×800, covering from approximately source x440–1502 at full height. Keep face, bouquet and hands intact. Align “Your first order. Her special day.” at x282/y610 in two lines of clear sky; place “Go now →” at x282 near y1240, left of the stems.
routes.typography: Georgia regular gives the offer a 260px numeral line and approximately 110px “off.” Arial bold supplies the 64px occasion; Arial regular handles 32px brand and 30px personal copy/action. The rhythm moves from one enormous figure to compact, readable lines.
routes.colorLogic: A flat dusty coral canvas and dark bark type frame the photograph’s cool sky. Keep all photo text over clear sky and verify at least 4.5:1 body contrast.
routes.originalTwist: The offer forms an open corner around the photograph: its large numeral sits above the image while “off” descends beside it. The personal message sits within the gift scene.

aiDirection.selectionReason: Select “The handover” (route 0). It gives Mother’s Day and the personal gift priority while making the exact demo offer and action legible within the same composition. The wider photo field protects the face, bouquet and hands. It is feasible with one editable photo, editable text and a flat background. Final optical spacing and local contrast require inspection during artwork production.

aiReview.summary: The campaign is coherent and finished, with all required wording preserved and a clear hierarchy at both supplied scales.
strengths: The oversized serif headline bridges the blue field and photographed sky, integrating the occasion with the image.
The portrait crop preserves the woman’s face, bouquet and both hands.
Consistent left alignment and strong contrast connect the personal message, offer and action without a detached promotional footer.
